preprocessing.input: upright RGB, transparent pixels flattened onto white
preprocessing.resize: aspect preserving longest edge 768; Pillow bilinear; white right/bottom padding to multiples of 64
preprocessing.output: 12 room logits; original model channels 21:33; argmax class mask; crop padding

models.quality: Reviewed assistance only. Two original published test plans: pixel accuracy 0.87195, mean class IoU 0.65622; room class errors remain. Rectangular ONNX/PyTorch label agreement >99.9995%. This is a small feasibility evaluation, not cadastral or Indian pilot accuracy.

models.license: Apache-2.0 model card; retain RF-DETR and checkpoint attribution

preprocessing.input: upright RGB selected crop; at most 2048 pixels per edge and 4,000,000 pixels total; retain source resolution
preprocessing.resize: Each tile uses Pillow bilinear to 432x432; no whole-raster downsampling
preprocessing.output: 200 object logits and 200 mask logits per tile; object sigmoid >0.5; half-pixel bilinear masks resized to tile raster; mask logits >0; higher-confidence instances paint first within each tile
preprocessing.confidence: uncalibrated instance sigmoid; maximum per pixel in tile overlaps, mean over each returned connected candidate
preprocessing.tiling: Single image up to 512 pixels per edge retains instance masks. Larger images: 512-pixel tiles, stride 384, row-major, final tile anchored to far edge, no padding. Union foreground at source pixel coordinates and retain maximum accepted instance confidence per pixel; connected regions become review candidates.

models.quality: Reviewed assistance only. Fixed 12 published OAM/OSM test tiles using this runtime: aggregate IoU 0.2874, precision 0.3418, recall 0.6434. Clear occupied tiles reach IoU 0.57–0.86; empty and blurred scenes show false positives. No threshold tuning. Single-tile feasibility results do not establish tiled boundary accuracy; overlap union may merge touching roofs and retain edge false positives. No cadastral or Indian pilot accuracy claim.
